sections.label: Notes
sections.text:
Week 1 sets the trend line for the whole mesocycle. Pick weights you could still hit the top of the range with in four weeks, not weights that impress you today.
Write down weight and reps for every set. If the numbers stop climbing over a month, the problem is food or sleep, not the program.

sections.label: Notes
sections.text:
Weekly check — training is about 40% of this:
Bodyweight up 0.5–0.75 lb this week? If the scale hasn't moved in two weeks, add 200 calories.
Protein at ~0.8–1.0 g per lb of bodyweight, every day, across 4+ meals.
Sleeping 7–9 hours. Short sleep measurably blunts muscle gain — nothing supplements around it.
Creatine monohydrate, 5 g, any time of day.
Every set logged. Numbers climbing over the month?

sections.label: Notes
sections.text:
Weekly check — training is about 40% of this:
Bodyweight up 0.5–0.75 lb this week? If the scale hasn't moved in two weeks, add 200 calories.
Protein at ~0.8–1.0 g per lb of bodyweight, every day, across 4+ meals.
Sleeping 7–9 hours. Short sleep measurably blunts muscle gain — nothing supplements around it.
Creatine monohydrate, 5 g, any time of day.
Every set logged. Numbers climbing over the month?
